node_9.description: This is Eddy Lin's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00 am, wake up and complete the morning routine from 7:00 am to 7:30 am, have breakfast from 7:30 am to 8:00 am, attend ordinary classes in classroom 1 from 8:00 am to 12:00 pm, have lunch from 12:00 pm to 12:30 pm, study music theory in the library room from 12:30 pm to 3:00 pm, practice piano in the music room from 3:00 pm to 5:00 pm, have dinner from 5:00 pm to 5:30 pm, work on amateur composition project in the music room from 5:30 pm to 9:00 pm, review music theory notes in the library room from 9:00 pm to 11:00 pm, wind down and prepare for bed from 11:00 pm to 12:00 am, sleep at 12:00 am.
